select r.* from requirement r left join document_block source on source.id = r.block_id where r.project_id = #{projectId} and r.extraction_status <> 'EXCLUDED' order by coalesce(source.block_index, 2147483647), r.document_id, r.id

select r.* from requirement r left join document_block source on source.id = r.block_id where r.document_id = #{documentId} and r.extraction_status <> 'EXCLUDED' order by coalesce(source.block_index, 2147483647), r.id

select r.*, coalesce(source.block_index, 2147483647) as source_order from requirement r left join document_block source on source.id = r.block_id where r.project_id = #{projectId} and r.extraction_status <> 'EXCLUDED' order by ${q.orderBy}, r.document_id, r.id limit #{q.size} offset #{q.offset}
select * from requirement where document_id=#{documentId} and extraction_status <> 'EXCLUDED' order by id for update
select * from requirement where document_id=#{documentId} order by id for update
select count(*) from requirement where project_id = #{projectId} and extraction_status <> 'EXCLUDED'
mapper.insert: insert into requirement (id, project_id, document_id, parse_run_id, block_id, section_path, customer_clause_no, title, original_text, requirement_text, metrics_json, extraction_status, review_reasons, version, created_at, source_refs_json) values (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{documentId}, #{parseRunId}, #{blockId}, #{sectionPath}, #{customerClauseNo}, #{title}, #{originalText}, #{requirementText}, #{metricsJson}, #{extractionStatus}, #{reviewReasons}, coalesce(#{version}, 0), #{createdAt}, #{sourceRefsJson})
mapper.update: update requirement set customer_clause_no = #{customerClauseNo}, title = #{title}, requirement_text = #{requirementText}, review_reasons = #{reviewReasons}, extraction_status = #{extractionStatus}, version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and version = #{version}

update requirement set confirmation_assignee_id=#{confirmationAssigneeId}, confirmation_assigned_by=#{confirmationAssignedBy}, confirmation_assigned_at=#{confirmationAssignedAt}, confirmation_assignment_reason=#{confirmationAssignmentReason}, version=version+1 where id=#{id} and version=#{version}
